front.title: Federation Between Capability Indexes: Crawl, Reciprocal Identification and Admission

abstract.t: This document describes how independently operated capability indexes discover each other by following discovery documents, how a reading index identifies itself to the index it reads, and an admission model that distinguishes a peer that is known from a peer whose catalogue is indexed. It also describes how an index can preview a peer's catalogue before admitting it. Payment, identity, reputation and invocation are out of scope. The document is intended as input to the DAWN gap analysis on federation between directories.
